content: 1. Nefazodone increases the levels or effects of levonorgestrel/ethinyl estradiol/ferrous bisglycinate by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Co-administration with CYP3A4 inhibitors may elevate plasma hormone concentrations. Non-hormonal contraceptives are recommended. 2. Nelfinavir significantly alters estrogen plasma levels, potentially reducing the efficacy of hormonal contraceptives. Non-hormonal contraceptives are recommended. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 3. Neomycin reduces the levels or effects of levonorgestrel/ethinyl estradiol/ferrous bisglycinate by altering intestinal flora. This applies only to oral forms of hormones. The risk of contraceptive failure is low, but caution and monitoring are advised. Antibiotics may decrease hormonal contraceptive efficacy. 4. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of levonorgestrel/ethinyl estradiol/ferrous bisglycinate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Hormonal contraceptive efficacy may be reduced. Use alternative or backup contraception during and for 28 days after discontinuing enzyme inducers. 5. Oral estrogens may reduce serum IGF-1 response to growth hormone analogs, potentially requiring higher growth hormone doses. Caution and monitoring are advised. 30.
